selected_primary_idea.title: LifeTrace: A Contextual Multi-Modal Evidence Ledger for Life Detection
selected_primary_idea.summary: An auditable evidence and follow-up framework that assesses biosignature, technosignature, and in-situ candidates against biological, technological, abiotic, artifact, interference, and contamination hypotheses.
selected_primary_idea.research_object: Evidence for biological or technological activity beyond Earth.
mechanism: Bind candidate signal, provenance, environment, retrieval sensitivity, and counter-hypotheses in a machine-readable record.
Assign bounded statuses instead of a universal alien-life score.
Attach recovery efficiency and population coverage to every negative result.
Rank follow-up observations by their expected ability to discriminate remaining hypotheses.
Require human review before any public candidate statement.

hypotheses.statement: Context-conditioned multi-feature assessment reduces overconfident biosignature claims at matched data quality.
hypotheses.falsification: If it does not improve calibration or false-candidate control relative to a single-feature baseline, H1 fails.

hypotheses.statement: Sensitivity and recovery cards make negative results more accurate and limited to their actual coverage.
hypotheses.falsification: If cards never alter negative-result conclusions, H2 fails.

hypotheses.statement: A shared provenance ledger reduces omission of alternative explanations across evidence modalities.
hypotheses.falsification: If blinded source audits have equal omission rates without the ledger, H3 fails.

hypotheses.statement: Expected-discrimination follow-up beats fixed follow-up at equal budget on registered synthetic cases.
hypotheses.falsification: If it does not improve correct classification or efficient ambiguity reduction, H4 fails.

competitive_ideas.title: Oxygen-Follow-Up Scheduler
competitive_ideas.reason_not_primary: Narrow to one biosignature class and does not serve technosignature or in-situ evidence.

competitive_ideas.title: Interference-Resilient SETI Archive
competitive_ideas.reason_not_primary: Strong radio module but not a cross-modal life-detection design.

high_risk_ideas.title: Universal Chemistry-of-Life Prior
high_risk_ideas.risk: A global prior could manufacture apparent precision from weakly constrained theory assumptions.

rejected_ideas.title: Universal Alien-Life Probability Score
rejected_ideas.rejection_reason: Conflates target habitability, candidate evidence, confirmation, and sensitivity-limited null results.

mcts_evolution.operation: add discriminating follow-up and null semantics
add recovery calibration and human-review gate

debate_summary.strength: Turns life-search claims into source-bound, alternative-aware, falsifiable inference records.
debate_summary.objection: Likelihood and alternative-hypothesis models can remain subjective.
debate_summary.guardrail: Use blinded synthetic cases, pre-registration, sensitivity analysis, and explicit unresolved outputs.
